name: Use cases

subjectOf.text: The predominant uses of blockchain technology in the private investment fund industry originate in holding crypto assets of various kinds, which indicates that the technology plays its primary role in front office and investment functions rather than in back office administration.
subjectOf.abstract: Figures 7 and 8 suggest that the private investment funds industry's predominant uses of blockchain technology originate in holding crypto assets of different kinds. This would suggest that blockchain technology plays a primary role in front office and investment functions.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2998033
scope_conditions: based on word cluster coding of fund marketing materials for n=74 funds

subjectOf.text: The balance between the commercial benefits and use cases attached to a token and the scarcity of its supply is critical in the issuance of a token offering.
subjectOf.abstract: The balance of commercial benefits of a token offering and associated use cases of the token in combination with supply scarcity is critical in the issuance of a token offering.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Crypto Economics - The Top 100 Token Models Compared (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3249860

subjectOf.text: Significant failure of decentralization projects is not merely tolerable but necessary and useful, because failures are how appropriate use cases get explored during the immature phase of the technology.
subjectOf.abstract: Significant decentralization project failures are necessary and useful while appropriate use cases are being explored .
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Vadhindran K. Rao, Stable Cryptocurrencies (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3396522
scope_conditions: during the early, pre maturity phase of decentralization technology

subjectOf.text: Decentralization technology is unlikely to proliferate without a core use case beyond store of value; banking, money transmission, and triple entry accounting are natural use cases but fall short of being universal use cases for public blockchains.
subjectOf.abstract: Moreover, without a core use case, other than the store of value, decentralization technology is less likely to proliferate.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Vadhindran K. Rao, Stable Cryptocurrencies (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3396522

subjectOf.text: Without a core use case other than the store of value provided by Bitcoin, decentralization technology is less likely to proliferate; banking, money transmission, and triple entry accounting are natural but insufficient as universal use cases for public blockchains.
subjectOf.abstract: Without a core use case, other than the store of value (in Bitcoin), decentralization technology is less likely to proliferate.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization - A Primer on the New Economy (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3406323

subjectOf.text: Without a core use case beyond Bitcoin's store of value function, decentralization technology is less likely to proliferate.
subjectOf.abstract: Without a core use case, other than the store of value (in Bitcoin), decentralization technology is less likely to proliferate.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization - Past, Present, and Future (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3411897
scope_conditions: absent a widely adopted killer application for public blockchains
